output.summary: Cabbage-family flowering plant of unknown origin, including oilseed rape and the distinct rutabaga subspecies. Oilseed rape has bright yellow flowers and oil-rich seeds; low-erucic food-grade cultivars provide canola oil.
output.edibilityNote: Low-erucic rapeseed cultivars yield food-grade canola oil; ordinary seed naturally contains mildly toxic erucic acid.
